captions.detailed: A heavy-duty tandem rear axle assembly for a truck, featuring a dual-beam chassis frame structure in matte black. Two parallel, dark cylindrical axle shafts are suspended underneath, each equipped with grey hub assemblies at both ends. Curved black torque rods connect the axles to the frame brackets. The wheel hubs are designed for continuous-rotation articulation, while the torque rods are mounted via revolute joints.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a tandem rear axle assembly for a heavy truck. The assembly should feature a rectangular chassis frame, two parallel solid axle beams suspended below via torque rods with revolute pivot brackets, and continuous-rotation wheel hubs on both ends of each axle.
captions.factory: Construct the main chassis frame using box primitives arranged in a rectangular ladder configuration. Create the axle beams using cylinders for the central shafts, paired with offset spheres or cylinders for the differential housings. Model the torque rods as swept profiles or angled cylinders connected to the frame via bracket shapes. Finally, construct the wheel hubs at the ends of each axle using concentric cylinders and small circular patterns of studs.
